$help: Copy this folder (or run: npm run new -- "Product Name"). Folder name = URL: /products/<folder-name>/. Keys starting with $ are ignored. Delete any line you don't need.
name: Product Name
subtitle: Short line under the name, e.g. 1 ct Oval Lab-Grown Diamond
$category: One of the keys in store/site.json → vocabulary.categories
$price: Number in the store currency, no $ or commas. Use null for 'Price on request'.
$tags: Free-form labels used by collections (e.g. signature, tennis, estate, best-seller)
$metals/stones: Keys from store/site.json → vocabulary. Used for filters and swatches.

images.alt: Describe the photo for screen readers

$images: Optional! Leave 'images' out and every photo in this folder is used, in filename order. The 2nd image is shown on hover. Paths starting with / point into the site (e.g. /assets/images/...).
summary: One or two sentences shown near the price and in search.
description:
The full story of the piece.

Leave a blank line between paragraphs. **Bold** and [links](/pages/contact/) work.
$options: type: swatch (metal colour dots) | button | size (dropdown) | text. 'add' adds to the price, 'inquire' switches the button to Enquire, 'image' jumps to that photo (counting from 0).
care: Store separately and clean with a soft jewellery cloth.
shipping: Made to order; timing and insured delivery are confirmed in writing before payment.
$studio: Optional. Adds a 'Make it yours in 3D' button that opens the Design Studio with these settings.
$sort: Lower numbers appear first in 'Featured' order.
